# Synova.AI

> AI-powered learning platform that teaches students step-by-step across maths, science, and exam prep — built to grow real understanding, not just deliver answers.

Synova.AI offers a personalised AI tutor, homework method-explainer, voice tutor, language practice, exam prep (PYQ-based), study planner, and peer study mode. Caregivers and teachers can monitor progress while respecting student privacy.
